title: The Man Waiting
summary: At a relay settlement used as neutral ground by travelers and locals, Ray Silvestro is already waiting for Brandon under yet another identity: the Surveyor. Eva and Jessie now recognize the setup before Brandon even answers.

panelPlan.text: Wide public room beneath the old relay tower: message boards, meal tables, travelers sleeping against walls, no sense of military control. Ray is conspicuously elegant among the dust.
Brandon enters with Eva and Jessie. Ray stands from a table laid for two, as if an appointment has begun exactly on time.
Eva and Jessie exchange a look before Ray speaks. Brandon notices their look before he looks at Ray.

title: The Appointment
summary: Ray says he was promised that the Surveyor would arrive today and settle an old betrayal. Eva presses on the promise rather than Brandon's identity, while Brandon tries to keep Ray from turning expectation into violence.

panelPlan.text: Ray answers Brandon's refusal to sit by asking whether he came all this way merely to stand; the confrontation then settles around the prepared table. A sealed letter and an old brass token sit between them.
Eva stands nearby, asking who arranged the meeting. Ray dislikes being questioned by someone he did not plan for.
Ray opens the letter enough to show a description of Brandon's coat, hair and mannerisms. The handwriting is not his.

dialogueInline.speaker: Ray
dialogueInline.text: You came all this way to stand?

dialogueInline.speaker: Brandon
dialogueInline.text: I came because you were waiting.

dialogueInline.speaker: Ray
dialogueInline.text: The preacher said you'd come today.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brandon
dialogueInline.text: What did he say I was coming to do?

dialogueInline.speaker: Ray
dialogueInline.text: Same hands. Same way of watching the door.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: Did Samuel tell you that too?

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: Then let's ask Samuel what he did tell you.

title: Samuel
summary: Eva finds Samuel not hiding but tending to a frightened family in a side room after a separate local dispute. He is exactly the preacher Isabella described, and his genuine pastoral care makes him harder to reduce to a con man.

panelPlan.text: Eva follows a familiar sun-faded coat into a crowded side room. Samuel is bandaging a boy's hand while calming two adults who are arguing over blame.
Jessie arrives behind Eva and recognizes from her expression that the search is over. Samuel notices them but finishes tying the bandage before acknowledging them.
Eva puts Isabella's name into the room. Samuel's face changes by less than Eva hoped, but enough.

dialogueInline.speaker: Samuel
dialogueInline.text: Give me until the bandage is done.

title: The Setup Man
summary: Pressed by Eva and Jessie, Samuel admits that Raina heard about the accidental Brannock incident and began investigating Brandon afterward. She then selected real unresolved identities from communities along his route and sent Samuel ahead to plant expectations. General Diaz and the Surveyor were deliberate tests. Merritt was different: the resemblance story existed before Samuel reached the Mirage, and he only amplified it by predicting Merritt's return.

panelPlan.text: Samuel finishes the bandage and Eva immediately makes him answer the question she promised: outside the side room, she blocks his path while Jessie leans against the opposite wall, giving him only one comfortable direction to look.
Samuel produces practical route notes listing Brannock, Diaz, Merritt and the Surveyor, with ordinary handwritten dates, locations and marks beside the places he visited.
Eva realizes the conspiracy is mundane enough to be worse: somebody has been deliberately using entire communities to test Brandon.

dialogueInline.speaker: Samuel
dialogueInline.text: Not mine. Raina heard about that afterward.

dialogueInline.speaker: Samuel
dialogueInline.text: Raina heard that story before I got there. I pushed it. I didn't start it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: So you found stories that were already hurting people and put Brandon's face into them.

dialogueInline.speaker: Samuel
dialogueInline.text: Because Raina thought one of those men was Brandon, and I was good at making people talk.

title: Raina's Question
summary: Raina arrives after Ray's confrontation has cooled and admits the accidental Brannock incident put Brandon on her trail. She believed some hidden human identity must explain why the mistake fit so well, then began engineering later encounters to make him reveal which identity was real.

panelPlan.text: Raina enters the public room on Samuel's admission that she was the one who believed a hidden identity would catch from the opposite door as Samuel, Eva and Jessie return. Brandon sees her and understands immediately that she is the she.
Ray remains nearby, angry to learn his grievance was used as leverage. Raina does not apologize by calling it necessary; she states what she did and why.
Brandon asks the simplest question: did it work? Raina looks at the four names on Samuel's list and cannot honestly say yes.

dialogueInline.speaker: Raina
dialogueInline.text: I did. I thought one name would catch.

dialogueInline.speaker: Raina
dialogueInline.text: Something you knew. A place. A person. A lie you had rehearsed badly.

dialogueInline.speaker: Raina
dialogueInline.text: I assumed I had the wrong bait.

dialogueInline.speaker: Raina
dialogueInline.text: No. It's all I can say without pretending it was better than it was.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brandon
dialogueInline.text: Did it tell you anything about me?

dialogueInline.speaker: Raina
dialogueInline.text: I believe the other answers failed.

title: The One She Didn't Plant
summary: The first arc ends with a precise distinction. Brannock was a genuine mistake that drew Raina's attention. Raina and Samuel later engineered General Diaz and the Surveyor, while Merritt was already an independent resemblance story before Samuel primed Isabella. Their conspiracy explains several appointments, not the existence of every candidate identity.

panelPlan.text: The group stands in the relay settlement's public room after the confrontation. The social danger has passed, but nobody feels relieved.

Eva answers Raina's claim that the other identities failed by working through Samuel's route notes in order. Brannock, Diaz and Surveyor carry Samuel's marks; Merritt points back to an earlier report from a traveler out of the Mirage and Isabella's preexisting damaged photograph.

Outside, Brandon walks toward the rig. Jessie follows. Eva lingers just long enough to hear Raina's answer, then runs after them. A distant Sunforge shape catches late light beyond the settlement; nobody looks at it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: So the thing that made you start doing this wasn't something you did.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brandon
dialogueInline.text: That wasn't the part I regretted.
